subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group and topic session keys include normalized bot account/app identity by default, and how should existing unscoped group sessions migrate?
rationale: The source issue is clear, but the fix changes a persistent session/security boundary where maintainers need to choose the canonical key shape, migration behavior, and how it coordinates with open Feishu mention-identity work.

options.title: Account-Scope Group Sessions
options.body: Make Feishu group/topic sessions include normalized account or app identity, add upgrade repair for existing unscoped sessions, and prove multi-bot target and non-target behavior.

options.title: Keep Shared Group Sessions
options.body: Document same-group multi-bot session sharing as unsupported or opt-in only, accepting the current identity-mixing risk until a broader Feishu model is designed.

options.title: Defer Behind Mention Identity
options.body: Resolve the open Feishu app-scoped mention identity work first, then revisit session isolation once target-bot admission is proven.

recommendation.title: Account-Scope Group Sessions
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group/topic sessions include normalized account or app identity, add upgrade repair for existing unscoped sessions, and prove multi-bot target and non-target behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-line and recent-history signal on the affected Feishu route/session surfaces.
